title: EUDI Wallet readiness checklist
summary: Authologic's free 20-question EUDI Wallet readiness self-assessment for regulated businesses, covering 6 areas with a scoring guide. Updated August 2026.
body_markdown:
*Last updated: August 6, 2026*


EUDI Wallet Readiness Checklist is a free 20-question self-assessment for banks and other regulated businesses preparing for mandatory EUDI Wallet acceptance.


It covers 6 readiness areas - Strategic Readiness, Customer Experience, Technology & Integration, Orchestration & Fallback, Compliance & Risk, and Future Scalability - with a scoring guide that tells you whether your organisation is Operationally Ready, In Progress, or Not Ready.


Built by Authologic from eID implementations across 236 countries and territories and integrations with 84 identity providers (as of August 2026).
